name: angel of death (meteor/spawn)
role: **Fully traced across two sessions.** The spell's own controller effect (class 7 type 0x13 "AoD" per unit_types) - its only job is sequencing the spawn, and it is itself INVISIBLE throughout (no drawable ever set): init plays sound 0xAC once ("spell landing"); per-turn tick 0 spawns a class-7 type 0x48 ("meteor") falling effect at its own position; every later tick polls that meteor object's liveness; once it's gone, calls create_aod (0x4DD700) to spawn the real class-1 type-8 person at the same spot, then frees itself. **The meteor sub-effect itself (state 59, below) is ALSO invisible** (confirmed, separate session) but trails 36 real visible "orbiter" spark particles and, on hitting the ground, spawns a real terrain-height-ripple "ground shockwave" (state 56, below) with sound 0xDA - this is the actual visible "ground transforms" moment, resolved this session. The angel's own ongoing hunting AI (class-1 PERSON state 28, person_states.tsv) only begins once create_aod hands off to it, run once synchronously at spawn.

name: whirlwind
role: The tornado's own per-turn body: counts down an active 'scan and damage' phase then a drifting/fading phase; re-walks a chain of effect objects for its progressive water/land colour change; while active, scans its own cell and acts on whatever it finds (persons -> their own class-1 state 24, buildings -> wood pull or destruction, scenery -> wood loss, vehicles -> a state-1 simple blast). See 'Whirlwind mechanics'.

name: insect plague (swarm)
role: The invisible cloud's own per-turn body: sound, home-leash steering, and gated bee-dot spawning (0x510D40, its own class-7 type 0x1B, a ~19-step sub-state cycle of its own at 0x510CB0 once it has a held reference unit). See 'Insect plague'.

name: firestorm
role: Firestorm's own per-turn body: gated fireball spawn. See 'Firestorm fireballs'.

name: erosion
role: Init 0x509DC8 sets duration +0x6C=64; 63 hydraulic-erosion passes via 0x4983A0 over an 8x8-cell jittered window, each cell floored at 0 (never below sea level). See 'Erosion passes'.

name: land bridge
role: Per-cell smoke, height step, refresh and neighbour notification - handler addresses known from the Reference table, body not re-derived in this investigation.

name: lightning

name: flatten
role: Named only via the per-component state list; the Flatten spell's own levelling effect. Own per-turn body not independently traced.

name: lava flow
role: Downhill spread, then fade, then ash. See 'Volcano lava flow'. Type 0x40's own effect (state 51, below) is spawned both deterministically by the volcano controller and probabilistically by this spread.

name: lava square
role: A single, non-spreading damaged-ground/fire cell (blend decays, self-destructs once low, keeps the ground on fire while blend is high) - used e.g. by Earthquake's fissure. See 'Volcano lava flow'.

name: (unnamed, type 0x40)
role: Entered directly by the type-0x40 init. Spawned deterministically by the volcano controller (cast turns 120-240) and probabilistically (~1/128 per hot cell per turn) by lava flow's own spread (state 33). Role beyond entry untraced - possibly a small ember/spark.

name: angel of death (ground shockwave)
role: Spawned by the meteor sub-effect (state 59, below) the instant it crosses the ground plane on impact. Plays sound 0xDA once; NO drawable of its own - a pure terrain effect, no sprite. 9-tick (0.75 s) life: each tick raises a ring of map cells at its own current, growing radius by its own current, decaying amplitude (64 down to 0 in steps of 8), while simultaneously subtracting that same amount from the previous (inner) ring to settle it back down, recomputing terrain each tick - a genuine outward-travelling height wave that rises then subsides as it propagates. The code-confirmed mechanism behind the user-reported "ground transforms first," exactly like a drop hitting water, implemented as real terrain height, rendered on land.

name: angel of death (meteor)
role: The falling meteor itself (class 7 type 0x48 "meteor" per unit_types), spawned by effect_aod (state 20, above). NO drawable of its own (confirmed invisible) - spawns at height 2048, falls at -256 units/tick (~8 ticks, 0.67 s). Its own tick 0 spawns 36 "orbiter" particles (class 7 type 0x46, a REAL visible glowing-particle billboard sprite, hfx 0x4BA/1210, draw class 0x2B/43 - the same renderer family as the bee-dot billboard) scattered with staggered lifetimes, trailing the invisible fall. The instant it crosses the ground plane, spawns the "ground shockwave" sub-effect (state 56, above) and self-destructs one tick later.
